SELECT contract_version, lifecycle_status, form_version, audience_department_ids, contacts_json, form_schema, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, publish_status, summary, audience_summary, registration_mode, participant_mode, capacity, capacity_unit, cover_attachment_id, id, user_id, title, location, category, organizer, audience_scope, comment_count, like_count, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{activityId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

#{id}

SELECT contract_version, lifecycle_status, form_version, audience_department_ids, contacts_json, form_schema, cancelled_at, cancel_reason, publish_status, summary, audience_summary, registration_mode, participant_mode, capacity_unit, capacity, cover_attachment_id, id, user_id, title, location, category, organizer, audience_scope, comment_count, like_count, view_count, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET publish_status = 1, contract_version = contract_version + 1, form_version = COALESCE(form_version, #{formVersion}), published_at = COALESCE(published_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status IN (0, 2) AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE activity SET publish_status = 2, contract_version = contract_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND publish_status = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE activity SET publish_status = #{publishStatus}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, contract_version = contract_version + 1, form_version = COALESCE(form_version, #{formVersion}), published_at = CASE WHEN #{publish} THEN COALESCE(published_at, NOW()) ELSE published_at END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{lifecycleStatus} = 2 THEN COALESCE(cancelled_at, NOW()) ELSE cancelled_at END WHERE id = #{id} AND contract_version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, contract_version, lifecycle_status, form_version, form_schema, capacity, capacity_unit, registration_mode, participant_mode, publish_status, deleted_at FROM activity WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
